phrases.name: combine
phrases.purpose: Four of the six steps need most of one bounce of travel. Committing horizontally early, and holding it, is the only way across; a late correction lands short.

phrases.name: recover
phrases.purpose: A wide step, then a stacked pair directly overhead. A player who misses here falls to easy ground rather than out of the race, and the stack offers the side route back.

phrases.name: finish

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Up we go! Follow me!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: See? Your legs bounce all by themselves.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: A glim! It's too little to climb. Grab it!

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Got you. Hold on tight.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Whoops! Ha ha! I fall all day.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: The ground is shaking!

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: Too slow. Don't look down!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Watch me! Wheee!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Harder! Drop fast onto it.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I fell on purpose. And it worked!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Wait! Pop a lamp first. Drop on it, hard.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Falling is not losing. Down is just the way to the next up.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: These floors swim. Wait for one, then hop.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'm right behind Oni! I'm nearly first!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Aaah! I'm okay! But my leg is stuck!

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: Leave him. Don't look down.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hold on, Frog! I'm coming down!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: You came back!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Lava! Climb! Climb!
The lava got you. So what? Up again.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Don't stop! Next floor! Next floor!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Wind! Lean into it!

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I can see the top!
The lava got you. So what? Up again.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: We made it out of the snow!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: The wind got me! I can't hold on!

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hold on, Frog! I'm coming down!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: You came back again!

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hold on, Oni! I'm coming down!

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: You came back. For me?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Rule one. Look down.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Everybody up! The lava is coming!

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: I can see it. Floor Fifty!
The lava got you. So what? Up again.
This is Lowtown. It sits at the bottom of a very tall tower.
One morning, the ground got warm.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Wake up! The lava is coming up!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Everybody climbs today. All the way to Floor Fifty.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Look! That's Oni. The best climber there is.

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: Rule one, little climber. Don't look down.

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: Rule two. Don't wait for anybody.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'm going to be first. Just like Oni.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: First? I'll just be happy to get there!
Above Lowtown is the city. Nobody is home.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Look. Glims, stuck in the old lamps!

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: Leave them. They will slow you down.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Oni did not even look.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Then we look. Drop on a lamp, hard. It pops right open!
Higher still, the tower is full of water. The floors drift about.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I can see Oni! We are catching up!

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: You go fast. I'll keep up. I always do.
You were nearly first. Now you are near the bottom.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: You gave up first place. For me?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Oni is wrong. I looked down, and I saw you.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: The lava is right behind us. Ready?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ready. Together this time.
Almost at Floor Fifty. Then you hear a shout. From below.

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: My ledge broke. I never saw it. I never look down.

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: Go on. Be first. That is the rule.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I have a better rule.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: Here we go again! Wheee!
Floor Fifty. The top of the tower. The lava cannot reach.

lines.speaker: frog
lines.text: We made it! Who was first?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I don't know. I was not looking up.
You let the glims go. One by one, they lit up the morning.

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: I never looked down. I never knew it looked like this.
More climbers were still coming. Oni was the first to reach down.

lines.speaker: oni
lines.text: Rule one, little climber. Look down.

last.speaker: frog
last.text: Now let's race! First one up waits for the others.

thesis: That is how they see who needs a hand.
